messages:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick thought 1: run a 3-week rapid-ramp for new SIs: week1 intro + labs, week2 live integration sprint, week3 certification & marketplace listing. Want to trial with 2 cloud partners and 1 HW partner. Thoughts?

Marco (PartnerEng): Sounds good. For labs we should include a 'private deploy smoke' and an "embed+search" quickstart. Each lab should be <1hr.

Tess (SI Enablement): Agree on cadence. Proposal: cohort size 6 integrators, 4 instructor-led sessions, 2 asynchronous labs, and a final 20-min demo per SI. Badge issued after demo pass + automated test.

LegalBot: Reminder: any badge that implies "Redwood-verified" must have a short TOS addendum. Tag @Legal to draft. :balance_scale:

Nikhil (Sales Ops): Want to add a "warm lead" metric to the program — list of customer prospects that match SI focus area. If an SI converts one of those within 90 days they get priority listing and a finder credit. Need GTM buyoff.

Signe (Marketplace): We can do priority listing but need a canonical tag and logo spec. I'll create a template and image spec to keep brand consistent.

Priya (Partnerships): Ops question to @ops-bot 1: Can we automate the verification smoke tests and badge issuance?

ops-bot: Automation check started. Available endpoints: POST /integrator/verify-run, GET /integrator/status/{id}. Expected results: /health == 200, inference latency < 300ms (dev env), prompt-responses pass similarity threshold >= 0.6.

Marco (PartnerEng): For HW partner, note that KMS/HSM setup will add latency to the checklist. Add a "KMS checklist" item for private deploy labs.

Tess (SI Enablement): Drafted a minimal assessment: 8 MCQs + 2 short answers + live demo rubric. Will post to /confluence/si/rapid-ramp by EOD.

Priya (Partnerships): Can we make the demo rubric partly automated? Example: demo must call the Redwood API using service account and show end-to-end from prompt->response. We can record logs and run a quick parser to validate calls.

ops-bot: New automation workflow created 1: redwood/si-ramp-v1. Triggers: when demo video uploaded or when /integrator/verify-run passes.

Nikhil (Sales Ops): I'll coordinate a small incentive: $1k marketplace credit for early adopters + co-marketing call. Finance OK for pilot.

Signe (Marketplace): I'll add the design card and a short partner spotlight template. Please send 1-2 customer quotes for the spotlight.

Priya (Partnerships): Next steps checklist:
- Finalize cohort invite list (Priya) [ ]
- Automation smoke tests configured (ops-bot / Marco) [ ]
- Assessment + demo rubric (Tess) [ ]
- Legal badge TOS (Legal) [ ]
- Marketplace listing template (Signe) [ ]
- Incentive terms + attribution rule (Nikhil) [ ]

Marco (PartnerEng): I'll schedule a dry-run with the HW partner next Thu.

Tess (SI Enablement): :rocket: Aiming to kick cohort on the 1st of next month. If anyone has blockers flag them here.

Priya (Partnerships): Great work team. I'll post the invite draft tomorrow and create JIRA -> SI-RAMP-1.
